scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving walking & getting around
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Walking and Getting Around
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: walking & getting around — a misunderstanding or problem involving walking & getting around
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving walking & getting around; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan and Ms Olivia get confused about which exit to meet at.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan và chị Olivia nhầm lẫn về lối ra để gặp nhau.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Olivia, I do not see the exit you mean.
turns.vietnamese: Olivia này, tôi không thấy lối ra chị nói.

turns.speaker: Ms Olivia
turns.english: I am at the north exit, near the sign.
turns.vietnamese: Tôi đang ở lối ra phía Bắc, gần tấm biển.

turns.speaker: Ms Olivia
turns.vietnamese: Tốt quá, gặp tôi ở đây nhé.
